account-name.description: Collected SamAccountName, not proof of the modifying account.

change-time.description: Normalized UTC ftimeLastOriginatingChange, only when supported and non-sentinel.

change-time-raw.description: Original ftimeLastOriginatingChange value; retains unavailable and sentinel times.

collection-server.description: Optional collector-provided LDAP server context; scopes local USNs.

domain-scope.description: Optional collector-provided domain context, not inferred from a DN.

link-created.description: Normalized UTC ftimeCreated, only when supported and non-sentinel.

link-created-raw.description: Original ftimeCreated value; retains unavailable and sentinel times.

link-deleted.description: Normalized UTC ftimeDeleted, only when supported and non-sentinel.

link-deleted-raw.description: Original ftimeDeleted value; retains unavailable and sentinel times.

linked-value-dn.description: Member column: linked DN for member or altRecipient metadata; not necessarily group membership.

object-created.description: Normalized UTC WhenCreated, only when supported and non-sentinel.

object-created-raw.description: Original WhenCreated value; retains unavailable and sentinel times.

object-dn.description: Distinguished name of the affected AD object; not the actor.

object-name.description: Collected object Name; not a historical name or actor attribution.

originating-dsa-dn.description: Originating directory server DN, not an authenticated actor.

raw-record.description: JSON representation of all original CSV columns and values; exact bytes remain attached.

record-index.description: One-based CSV data-record index, not physical line number.

review-status.description: Analyst review state; source metadata does not confirm malicious activity.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact attached source export.

version.description: dwVersion counter as reported, retaining exact decimal text.

description: An Active Directory replication metadata observation, including attribute or linked-value changes, server-scoped counters and source provenance. Replication metadata is partial last-change evidence, not a complete audit trail or actor attribution.
name: ad-replication-metadata
